messages:
maya: Heads up — new hire Aisha Patel starts Mon. Running into name vs SSN issue: passport says "Aishah Patel" (minor spelling), SSN application still pending. She's remote in Berlin and needs I-9 verification, BG intake, laptop courier + day-1 orientation. Can we confirm acceptable I-9 flows for EU remote hires and whether benefits enrollment can proceed with a placeholder SSN?

ben: Do we have her visa status? If passport name doesn't match offer, we need a signed name-change addendum or matching ID. For I-9 specifically, we must physically inspect original docs — we usually use an authorized local notary/agent as our rep when hires are remote. Manager still needs to sign Section 2 within 3 business days after agent verifies.

maya: She's not on a US visa — German citizen. Good to know on the notary flow. Can we get vendor details? Also BG portal email never arrived for her. I tried resending but it bounced.

julie: I'll take vendor. We have a Berlin partner (NotaryNow) who does authorized rep checks and e-sign uploads. I can book a 9:15 CET slot Mon. @maya please confirm morning works.

it-ops-bot: Laptop order created: order RWF-89521, standard image. ETA delivery window Mon 09:00-12:00 CET. Tracking: https://ship.redwood.example/RWF-89521

ben: For benefits: benefits team confirmed we can provision enrollment with placeholder SSN (000-00-0000) for non-US hires and update later. Please annotate Workday with SSN pending and attach proof of SSN application.

maya: Julie — please book notary and email Aisha this checklist: 1) bring original passport, 2) bring government photo ID (if different), 3) screenshot of SSN application confirmation, 4) signed offer addendum if name differs. I'll resend BG invite. Command: `/bg-resend aisha.patel@redwood.example`

julie: Booked NotaryNow — Lena, Mon 09:15 CET. I added a 30m Day-1 orientation at 10:30 CET (remote) and included a calendar jump link to the notary appointment. Vendor contact: +49 30 1234 5678. I'll upload signed docs to HR folder once we get them.

ben: BG invite resent and email delivery confirmed. Manager reminder: when agent completes Section 2, ask them to include a short verifier note (name, company, phone) and we'll attach to the I-9 packet.

maya: Great — Aisha confirmed morning. I'll send the benefits enrollment link now and note placeholder SSN. Also flag: Berlin office badge pickup is closed Mon (local holiday) so badge courier will deliver Tue. cc: @it-ops-bot for delivery scheduling. :calendar:
